title: Structural rationalization of GSPT1 and IKZF1 degradation by thalidomide molecular glue derivatives.
authors: Nowak, Radoslaw P; Che, Jianwei; Ferrao, Silas; Kong, Nikki R; Liu, Hu; Zerfas, Breanna L; Jones, Lyn H
one_liner_zh: 该文研究沙利度胺分子胶降解GSPT1和IKZF1的结构机制，虽涉及锌指转录因子IKZF1的蛋白降解，但核心是CRBN-底物互作而非TF-DNA结合，方法含分子对接和MD但对象偏离本课题。
abstract: Thalidomide and its derivatives are molecular glues that bind cereblon (CRBN), a component of an E3 ubiquitin ligase complex, and mediate protein interactions with neosubstrates resulting in their polyubiquitination and proteasomal degradation. The structural features of neosubstrate binding have been elucidated that highlight key interactions with a beta-hairpin degron containing a glycine, which is present in a wide-range of proteins, including zinc-finger transcription factors such as IKZF1, and the translation termination factor GSPT1. Here, we profile 14 closely-related thalidomide derivatives in CRBN occupancy, and IKZF1 and GSPT1 degradation cell-based assays, and use crystal structures, computational docking and molecular dynamics to delineate subtle structure-activity relationships. Our findings will enable the rational design of CRBN modulators in the future, and help avoid the degradation of GSPT1 which is broadly cytotoxic.
abstract_zh: 沙利度胺及其衍生物是分子胶，它们结合cereblon (CRBN)，一种E3泛素连接酶复合物的组分，并介导与新底物 (neosubstrates) 的蛋白质相互作用，导致其多聚泛素化和蛋白酶体降解。新底物结合的结构特征已被阐明，突出了与含甘氨酸的β-发夹降解子 (beta-hairpin degron) 的关键相互作用，该降解子存在于多种蛋白质中，包括锌指转录因子如IKZF1，以及翻译终止因子GSPT1。在此，我们通过CRBN占据率以及IKZF1和GSPT1降解的细胞实验，对14种密切相关的沙利度胺衍生物进行了分析，并利用晶体结构、计算对接和分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 来描绘细微的结构-活性关系。我们的发现将有助于未来CRBN调节剂的合理设计，并帮助避免GSPT1的降解，因其具有广泛的细胞毒性。
